name: MiniVerifier-Gate
role: four-head span-node admissibility scorer inside UC-DG
label_sources_described_in_manuscript: adjudicated node-path labels for the human-audit subset
cached verifier traces for high-confidence train candidates
loss: sum of four binary cross-entropy losses with class-balanced weights and 1e-4 L2 regularization
calibration: temperature scaling on validation split; ECE with 10 equal-frequency bins
threshold_policy: validation F1 maximization under a minimum precision constraint; thresholds frozen before test evaluation
fallback_policy: fallback evaluator receives only candidates in the uncertainty interval
runtime_contract: the local scorer endpoint returns one role/node_identity/stage/evidence score vector for every reasoning-unit/node record
stage_gate_boundary: stage evaluates source-backed operator-scope compatibility with the local evidence; it does not test candidate_stage <= target_stage
note: This record documents the verifier implementation described in the manuscript. It is not a substitute for private or copyrighted raw training records.
